metadata.projectName: Unit 210 Cultivation, Nursery & Edible Kitchen Suite
metadata.revisionName: Concept 1 — Right-Sized 320-Plant Veg Rooms, Expandable Edible Clean Room & Secure Product Vault

rooms.name: Zone K-V: Edible Secure Product Vault
rooms.subtitle: Cannabis Inputs, WIP Batches & Finished Goods
rooms.notes: Dedicated Regulatory Limited Access Secure Product Storage Vault (139 SF) for the Edible Zone. Houses separate locked bays for Cannabis Inputs (distillate/extracts), In-Progress Batches (curing/COA hold), and Finished Packaged Products.

rooms.name: Existing Restroom & Plumbing Core
rooms.notes: Existing ADA restroom (7'-8" x 9'-2"). Wet wall shared with Zone K sinks on South and relocated Janitorial Utility Sink on South-West.

rooms.name: Zone K: Edible Clean Room
rooms.subtitle: Expandable Modular Clean Room (200 SF)
rooms.notes: Anchored on East wall & existing utility sink plumbing stub to minimize trenching. Modular West & South walls allow direct expansion into the 300+ SF reserve directly South.

rooms.name: Zone K Expansion Reserve
rooms.subtitle: Phase 2 Clean Room Reserve (+300 SF)
rooms.notes: Dedicated expansion envelope directly South of Zone K's modular non-load-bearing wall, allowing Zone K to expand from 200 SF to 500+ SF.

rooms.name: Zone M: Mother & Prop. (Phase 1)
rooms.subtitle: Phase 1 Nursery • Closed-Loop • 32 Moms & 640 Cuttings
rooms.notes: Phase 1 Nursery Build-Out (484 SF Closed-Loop Environmental Zone). Houses 32 Mother plants (8 moms per 4'x8' bench x 4 benches @ ~20 cuts/mom = 640 cuttings) plus two Vertical Cloning Racks.

rooms.name: Zone V: Vegetative 1 (Phase 2)
rooms.subtitle: Phase 2 Nursery • Closed-Loop • 320 Plants (2 Strains x 160)
rooms.notes: Phase 2 Nursery Build-Out (616 SF Closed-Loop Environmental Zone). East wall encloses center steel column COL-1. Houses ten 4'x8' rolling benches (5 Left = 160 plants Strain A; 5 Right = 160 plants Strain B; 320 plants total).

rooms.name: Zone W: Vegetative 2 (Phase 3)
rooms.subtitle: Phase 3 Nursery • Closed-Loop • 320 Plants (2 Strains x 160)
rooms.notes: Phase 3 Nursery Build-Out (616 SF Closed-Loop Environmental Zone). Framed 5'-0" x 5'-6" Dry Electrical Closet at NW corner isolates the existing West-wall Power Box (MDP-1) with 38" NEC 110.26 clearance. Top-left bench (VB2-2) is stepped back to 4'-6" wide to clear the electrical closet.

rooms.name: Zone L: Logistics & Main Corridor
rooms.subtitle: 9'-9" Main Spine, Potting, Medium & Locked Waste
rooms.materialCallout: Sealed Concrete • Full 4'x8' Rolling Bench & Pallet Spine
rooms.notes: Connects North main double-door entry down a wide 9'-9" central corridor spine to all zones and South loading docks. Includes Potting Stations, Soil/Medium Storage, and Regulatory Locked Cannabis Waste Container.
